{{Top|leg}}
'''Business Zone 6''' was a residential section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was the location of a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] counter-terrorism operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Jabiimi]] terror cell used a home inside an affluent neighborhood as their hideout.<ref name="tz">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
